LESSON: COMPUTER CONCEPTS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Foundations of Pre-Technical Studies
Topic 1.3: Computer Concepts

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Computer Concepts
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why are computers classified differently?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain the characteristics of a computer in a user environment
2. classify computers used in day-to-day life
3. use a computer to perform tasks in a user environment

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: explain the characteristics of a computer in a user environment

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: explain the characteristics of a computer in a user environment
• Model 2: classify computers used in day-to-day life
• Model 3: use a computer to perform tasks in a user environment

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: explain the characteristics of a computer in a user environment
2. Practise: classify computers used in day-to-day life
3. Practise: use a computer to perform tasks in a user environment

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Computer Concepts.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why are computers classified differently?
2. How are computers used in day-to-day life?
